_comment: Seasonal events the 1.12 metagame runs (SEASONAL_EVENTS_FILE). Each event is served in
/game_tuning/seasonal_event_schedule while start..end covers now, and its featureFlags are
forced on in the client and gameserver by the runtime DLL (GET /undaunted/feature_flags).
Dark Harvest: EVENT_DARKHARVEST is the EventId of the EVENT_DARKHARVEST_* quest series; the Dark_Harvest_* ids
show the five ciphers in Ramsgate's Dark Harvest level (lore_object_bp hides one unless its EventId is scheduled);
world servers answer schedule checks from this schedule through the runtime DLL, fetched once per launch;
city_event_dark_harvest_bpff streams Ramsgate's Dark Harvest level (decorations, the Unseen),
city_event_stall_bpff the event stall (Ozz). Remove an event or move its end to switch it off;
the DLL reads the flags once per launch, so clients and world servers need a restart.
eventPasses: progression tracks served with the event's window (the Unseen Recruit event pass).
storeTags: store tags listed and sold only while the event runs (Honest Ozz's Event Store, the event pass premium).
